# Native JPEG color-transform controls

Generated by `scripts/jpeg_color_native_controls.py` using unmodified libjxl
v0.12.0 (`a7a9c78`). These explicit 16x8 sources use unequal component DC
values 1, 3 and 7, with zero AC, making the first two planes distinguishable.
The JPEG component identifiers and APP signals vary independently. Native
rendering and exact JPEG reconstruction are required before accepting a row.

The `.rgb16.txt` files contain complete PNG16 samples extracted using the
existing `scripts/upstream-audit/pngdiff.py` reader. PPM output is not used:
the native PPM writer ignored the requested precision in the first preparation
attempt. That attempt is retained separately and supplies no PNG16 evidence.
